newsitem.title: SYRIA: Snow blankets Damascus, first time in five years.
newsitem.headline: Snow blankets Damascus, first time in five years.

text.p: Snow blanketed the ancient city of Damascus for the first time in five years as residents woke up on Saturday to find streets covered with snow.
The meteorological department said the snowfall was around three inches in the capital Damascus and 10 inches in the mountains.
Roads on the outskirts of the capital and south Syria have been closed since Friday night because of poor weather conditions.
